thread:
sophie: Quick summary from the GPTQ bakeoff run this week across Llama-70B, Mistral-7B-v0, and Qwen-14B. Focus was on 4-bit GPTQ (per-channel, per-tensor variants) + AWQ baseline. Ran instruction-following, long-context (8k), math, and code evals.

mike: Nice. What's the headline on accuracy deltas vs FP16?

sophie: TL;DR: AWQ-4 (channel) kept perplexity within 3-5% of FP16 on Llama-70B for short prompts but showed a ~12% increase in instruction hallucination rate (our instr-hall metric) on multi-step tasks. GPTQ-4 (our non-AWQ variant) had slightly worse math accuracy (drop ~6%) but better stability on code generation (fewer compile failures).

raj: Can you paste the quick numbers? Even roughs help for prioritization.

sophie: Sure — rough deltas (relative to FP16, positive = worse):
- Llama-70B GPTQ-4 per-channel: perplexity +4%, instr-hall +12%, math acc -6%, code-compile-fail +1%
- Llama-70B AWQ-4: perplexity +3%, instr-hall +9%, math acc -3%, code-compile-fail +3%
- Mistral-7B GPTQ-4: perplexity +6%, instr-hall +18% (bad on chain-of-thought), math acc -8%
- Qwen-14B GPTQ-4: perplexity +5%, instr-hall +7%, math acc -2%, longcontext drop (8k) latency regressions on KV cache

ana: Noted the Mistral spike. Were these models in instruction-tuned repository or raw base?

sophie: All were instruction-tuned checkpoints from model-catalog. Mistral had heavier instruction fine-tune mix -> I suspect that interacts poorly with our quant zeros in attention.

eva: Did we try per-layer mixed-precision (keep attention/ln at FP16)? Any ablation?

sophie: Yes — hybrid 4bit where we keep layernorms and all attention Q/K/V weights in FP16 reduced instr-hall by ~5 percentage points on Mistral, and fixed most long-context KV drift on Qwen. Trade-off: model size +10% and slight latency bump (~4ms/token).

mike: Operationally, for Dedicated pools what's recommended? AWQ for Llama on latency-sensitive routes, hybrid-GPTQ for Mistral?

sophie: Proposed rollout profiles:
- Hosted API (default): AWQ-4 per-channel for Llama variants with canary on 1% traffic; enable prompt-level eval hooks for hallucination detectors.
- Dedicated (SLA customers): hybrid-GPTQ (keep LN/attn FP16) for Mistral family; provide quant-profile toggle in console to flip to full-FP16 on regressions.
- Private: recommend full FP16 unless customer opts-in for quant cost saves; provide preflight eval harness.

raj: Any examples of failing prompts to add to repos?

sophie: Pasting two repros (shortened):
```
# math chain-of-thought failure (Mistral GPTQ-4)
Q: "If I triple a number and add 5 I get 20. What is the number? Show steps."
Expected: arithmetic steps -> 5
Model (GPTQ-4): incorrect intermediate step leading to 6
```
```
# longcontext KV drift (Qwen GPTQ-4)
Prompt: 7k tokens context then "What did user ask in paragraph 3?"
Model: returns unrelated paraphrase from paragraph 1
```

ana: Good artifacts. Can we add automated regression checks that fail a rollout when instr-hall delta > 8% or math acc drops >5%?

sophie: Yep that's my recommendation. We wired an eval job in CI: run 500 instruction probes + 200 math items + 100 code compile checks. Thresholds: instr-hall 8%, math -5%, code compile -3%. If fail -> block canary expansion.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: model=llama-70b-awq-4 channel=hosted canary=1% ts=2152467905

eva: One more note — batching settings matter. For AWQ we saw latency-optimal batch_size=8, for hybrid-GPTQ batch_size=4 due to KV memory growth. Marking in the ops runbook.

mike: Awesome writeup. Next steps: add the Mistral-specific LN/attn FP16 profile to model-catalog as "mistral-hybrid-v1", and schedule a customer-impact review for Dedicated customers next Wed.

sophie: On it — I'll push the profile and the failing repros to /repo/evals/gptq-bakeoffs and ping here when done.

raj: Thanks. Short follow-up: do we want to trial AWQ-8 (8-bit) on Qwen for longcontext before hybrid? Might save memory and reduce KV drift?

sophie: Good call — adding AWQ-8 baseline to next sweep.

mike: 👍 :rocket:
